description: Turns one notification channel on or off for this project and returns the full updated list. Affects monitoring notifications only. Switching a channel off here does not disconnect it from the account — other projects keep using it.

channel_id.description: Id of the channel inside its own list — as returned by `project_channel_list`, `notification_email_list`, `telegram_linked_list` or `max_linked_list`. For work chats (`chat_webhook`) take it from `project_channel_list`.

confirm.description: Set to true to authorize this write/destructive call even if STATUSER_ALLOW_WRITE is not enabled in the server config. Required for one-off overrides.

name: project_channel_set
title: Switch a channel on or off in a project
